Hello {{organisation_name}} team,

OPDA is creating the Smart Property Data Trust Framework: a governed family of connected domain
models intended to make property information clearer, more reusable and easier to exchange. We
are now recruiting practitioners and subject-matter experts for the {{context_name}} Working Group.

Could you share this opportunity with {{audience_description}} in your membership or network?

The group will focus on {{context_scope}}. Participants can contribute {{contribution_examples}}.
They are not being asked to understand ontologies, adopt AI or have technical knowledge. OPDA
will turn the evidence and expertise they provide into model candidates for human review and
feedback.

View and share the invitation
{{signup_url}}

Registration is an expression of interest, not automatic membership or access. Each person
registers directly and is reviewed by OPDA before onboarding.

We are not asking you to provide a member list. Please share the public registration link with
people for whom it is relevant. Sharing the opportunity does not imply endorsement or partnership.

If another contact in your organisation is better placed to consider this request, please feel
free to forward this message or reply to smartdata@openpropdata.org.uk.

Thank you,

Smart Property Data Trust Framework
